verdict.rationale: The official CLI can read runs and pull analytics from a script or CI, and its `raw` mode emits plain JSON that can be piped to a file. That makes a scripted export of trace data possible as a workaround, but nothing documents a native bulk-export capability. missing for 10: native bulk export of traces, any dataset export, blob-storage (S3/GCS) destinations, data-warehouse connectors (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery), scheduled/streaming export, independent corroboration.
